## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Wait until the current ledger timestamp is past the intent expires_at before calling reclaim_expired.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let now = f.env.ledger().timestamp();
let id = schedule_intent(&f, now, now + DAY);
rejected!(f.client.try_reclaim_expired(&id));
```
